RBI Governor Highlights India's Fintech Leadership and MSME Credit Gap

Reserve Bank of India Governor Shaktikanta Das has stated that India is at the forefront of digital innovation due to fintech. He described fintech as a bridge that connects everyone and specifically highlighted its role in helping Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) bridge their credit gap. These statements position India as a leader in the global fintech landscape.
